tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Screen background behind solid content (lists, profile, chat). Dark is the night teal-navy of the Ganapps logo ground. Tailwind `bg-background`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `card`, `muted` and every glass fill (16:1 or better in both themes). Tailwind `text-foreground`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Solid content surfaces: event rows, stat tiles, info cards, settings groups. Content lives on solid card, never on glass.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`. Same ink as `foreground`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, modals and the opaque body of bottom sheets once expanded past half height.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Ganapps green, unchanged from the current app. Fills the one main action per view (Log In, Enter Event Hub, Send), selected chips, cluster pins and the unread dot. Always paired with `primary-foreground` ink, never white.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label ink on a `primary` fill (6.5:1). Replaces the old white-on-green, which measured 2.3:1.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Green used AS text or a thin icon: links (Forgot Password?, Sign Up), the active tab label and glyph, ghost buttons, the selected segment label. 5.1:1+ on `background`, `card`, every glass fill and the `glass-lens` droplet over any map color, in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-lime
tokens.usage: The lime of the G-pin mark. Reserved for brand moments: the splash glow, the Map tab mark ring and your own location puck. Not for buttons or text.

tokens.name: like
tokens.usage: Filled heart and like counts. Pair with the heart glyph, never color alone.

tokens.name: save
tokens.usage: Filled bookmark for saved Ganaps.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary solid action (My Code, Sign Out). Dark is lifted off the navy ground so it still reads as a button.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label ink on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: the solid segment track, avatar initials ground, skeletons, disabled controls.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata (organizer, date), placeholders, inactive tab labels, helper text. 5.1:1+ on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `glass-fill-strong`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Pressed and hovered row background on solid surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete account, Leave event confirmation) and field errors. Always with a verb label. Light is red-700 so white labels keep 4.8:1 even under the bezel sheen.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Label ink on a `destructive` fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info banner ground (Public visibility pill, reduced-accuracy notice).

tokens.name: info-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `info`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning banner ground.

tokens.name: warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `warning`.

tokens.name: notice
tokens.usage: Organizer announcement highlight ground.

tokens.name: notice-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `notice`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around solid cards. Decorative only; anything interactive uses `input`.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Outline of text fields, outline buttons and unselected chips on solid ground (3:1+ on `background` and `card`).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable control. 4.6:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The default liquid-glass body for controls floating over the map: the tab bar island, map control buttons, top-bar actions. Thin on purpose, so the map glows through. Glyphs and one-word labels only, in `foreground`, `on-glass-muted` or `on-glass-primary`. No sentences.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Glass that carries sentences or inputs: the map search bar, toasts, the peek state of the Ganap sheet, the chat composer, chips. Keeps `foreground`, `primary-text` and `on-glass-muted` at 4.5:1 over every map color and map glow.

tokens.name: glass-fill-solid
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The Reduce Transparency fallback and the default on Android, where GlassView renders as a plain View. Same shape, rim and shadow; no blur.

tokens.name: glass-ice
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The brightest light in the material: the top-left stop of the rim and the tint that runs across a glass body. Never a fill or a text color.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The green light inside glass: the bottom-right stop of the rim, the floor light and the inner volume. A lighter step of Ganapps green, so the whole system stays one hue. It is light, not paint: never a control fill or a text color. `primary` stays reserved for the one main action.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The quiet middle of the rim ring, between its lit top-left (`glass-ice`) and bottom-right (`mint`) ends. The rim is what makes glass read as an object rather than a blur.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The specular sweep that falls across the top-left corner of a glass shape and fades out before mid-width.

tokens.name: glass-lens
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The droplet under the selected glass segment, the chosen reaction in the tray and a pressed menu row: a brighter glass inside the glass.

tokens.name: glass-tint-primary
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Green-tinted glass for a primary action that floats over imagery (Send in the composer, Directions on the map) and for quiet green grounds (icon discs, the Joined badge). Label in `on-glass-primary`.

tokens.name: on-glass-primary
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Label and icon ink on `glass-tint-primary` (7.7:1+).

tokens.name: on-glass-muted
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Secondary text on any glass fill: metadata in a floating row, placeholders in the search bar and composer, toast messages. Inside glass, `muted-foreground` resolves to this, because flat grey loses contrast over a moving backdrop. 4.5:1 or better on `glass-fill-strong`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Dims the screen behind a modal sheet or dialog.

tokens.name: primary-glow
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The soft halo under a selected map pin and the active-tab droplet.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. A pool of green light behind glass: the `Lobe` on solid screens and the glow over busy parts of the map. Glass needs light behind it to look like glass. Keep the centre off-canvas or away from `muted-foreground` text.

tokens.name: glow-lime
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The outer ring of a `Lobe` and the second map glow, in the lime of the G-pin mark.

tokens.name: bezel-sheen
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The specular highlight on a solid control (primary, secondary and destructive buttons, the selected chip, cluster pins). It falls on the top-left corner only and is gone before the label, so labels keep their contrast.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Mapbox style: land fill. The night style matches `background` so glass sits on a calm ground.

tokens.name: map-block
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Mapbox style: building footprints.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Mapbox style: minor roads.

tokens.name: map-road-major
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Mapbox style: arterials (Diversion Road, Iznart).

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Mapbox style: water (Iloilo River, Guimaras Strait).

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Mapbox style: parks and plazas.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Mapbox style: street and place labels. Labels stay quiet so pins and glass lead.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Intentional addition. The wordmark-sized title on Welcome and the splash. Once per screen. Tracking -1.51px.

styles.name: headline-lg
styles.usage: Tab screen titles and the Ganap title on its detail page. `text-headline-lg font-allo-bold`. Tracking -0.78px.

styles.name: headline-md
styles.usage: Section and sheet titles, chat header name. `text-headline-md font-allo-semibold`. Tracking -0.06px.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Card titles, row titles, button labels at md size. Tracking +0.22px.

styles.name: body-xl
styles.sample: Find what is happening across Iloilo.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph on Welcome and empty states. Tracking -0.09px.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: No announcements yet. The organizer will post updates here.
styles.usage: Default body copy, input text, chat messages. Tracking +0.04px.

styles.name: body-md
styles.usage: Metadata, helper text, list secondary lines, chip labels (at 600). Tracking +0.16px.

styles.name: label-md
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrows and stat captions. Tracking +1.03px.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Tab bar labels, timestamps in chat bubbles, badge text. Tracking +0.38px.

tokens.name: space-base
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon to badge, dot offsets. Tailwind `p-base`.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a control; gap between stacked chips. `gap-xs`.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and segments; gutter between cards (`gutter-mobile`). `p-sm`.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Card padding and the screen side margin (`margin-mobile`). `p-md`.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen. `gap-lg`.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Above a screen's primary action group; Welcome hero spacing. `gap-xl`.

tokens.name: space-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (ADR 0005, `MIN_TOUCH_TARGET`). Every pressable reaches 48px by size or hitSlop. `min-h-touch`.

tokens.name: space-margin-mobile
tokens.usage: Screen edge margin. `px-margin-mobile`.

tokens.name: space-gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Gap between grid items. `gap-gutter-mobile`.

tokens.name: space-island-inset
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Gap between the floating tab bar and the bottom safe-area edge, and its side inset beyond the screen margin.

tokens.name: space-tabbar-clearance
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Bottom padding every tab screen's scroll content needs (plus the safe-area inset) so the last row clears the floating island: 64px bar + 12px inset + 20px breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tiny marks: unread badges with a count, progress tracks. `rounded-sm`.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Segment lenses, thumbnails, image corners inside cards. `rounded-md`.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs and rectangular buttons. `rounded-lg`.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, event rows, the segment track, toasts. `rounded-xl`.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Bottom sheets (top corners) and the hero image on Ganap detail. Matches the iPhone display corner so sheets nest concentrically.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and circles: the tab bar island, chips, map controls, avatars, the primary button on glass. `rounded-full`.

shadow.note: Glass shadows combine an outer drop (lift) with inner rim light. Dark values are deeper because the ground is darker.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Solid cards resting on `background`. `shadow-sm`.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Primary button and selected pins. `shadow-md`.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The glass material: a hairline, a top highlight, a `mint` floor light, an inner volume and one offset drop shadow. Every glass control and surface except the island and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-island
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The floating tab bar island, the action bar and sheets: the highest layer, so the thickest glass and the deepest lift.

tokens.name: shadow-lens
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The selected glass segment and the chosen reaction: a lit lens with a faint green bloom under it.

tokens.name: shadow-bezel
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The lit volume on every solid control: a bright top edge and a soft light pooled along the bottom, so the fill reads as a capsule and not a flat pill. The stylesheet adds a drop glow in the fill color of the control.

tokens.name: shadow-bezel-pressed
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The pressed state of any control, solid or glass: the glow and the lift collapse and the light turns inward, so a press reads as the control being pushed in.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The carved-in counterpart of the bezel: text fields, the segment track and the composer field sit in a well, so raised means pressable and recessed means typeable.

blur.note: Backdrop blur radii for the CSS glass fallback (web, Storybook). On iOS 26 GlassView renders the real material and ignores these.

tokens.name: blur-thin
tokens.usage: Small glass: chips and pins over the map.

tokens.name: blur-regular
tokens.usage: Default glass: map controls, search bar, toasts, composer.

tokens.name: blur-thick
tokens.usage: The tab bar island and sheets, the layers that float highest.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation boost on every glass fallback, so map color glows through instead of turning grey.

rim.note: Width of the lit rim ring on glass. It scales with the surface: a thick rim swallows a small control.

tokens.name: rim-hair
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Glass under 32px tall: the reaction pill, the pin label, progress tracks.

tokens.name: rim-sm
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Small controls: chips, 36px icon buttons, the tab lens, the selected segment, map pins.

tokens.name: rim-md
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. The default: 48px buttons and icon buttons, the search bar, toasts, the composer.

tokens.name: rim-lg
tokens.usage: Intentional addition. Large surfaces: the tab bar island, the action bar, sheets, menus.
